posts.text:
I am heartbroken to hear of the shooting that took place in Co-Op City, especially knowing that the public safety officers were injured while conducting a wellness check to help someone in need.  All victims of this shooting are expected to survive, and my prayers remain with them as they heal from this tragedy. 

We must continue to work towards a reality without the fear of deadly weapons being accessible to anyone who wants to cause harm. 

https://t.co/lLcLNSYDlk

Just another Sunday at home, starting with church services in Rye, farmers market visits in Scarsdale and Irvington, the grand opening of JustinTime Baseball in Mamaroneck, and a luncheon group at Christ Temple in Greenburgh, ending with a wonderful free concert at Saunders High https://t.co/lpXbWmsX0a

By establishing emergency feeding operations in community health centers, we can ensure patients have reliable access to nutrient-rich food alongside their healthcare. 

That’s why, last week on the House Floor, I highlighted my new bill, the Food Access in Community Health https://t.co/CUVgygnWe8

I had a great time attending the EF New York Culture Fair in Tarrytown alongside local students and Mayor Karen Brown! Seeing international students have the opportunity to share their cultures with young learners is what true community building is all about. https://t.co/MMlVSzxn5u

Millions of Americans who rely on SNAP benefits through broad-based categorical eligibility are now at risk of losing their assistance.

With basic necessities like food becoming out of reach for so many, we must fight to protect those who depend on SNAP to feed their families. https://t.co/kiHy9aycyb

I am proud to have voted to pass the Major Richard Star Act out of the House. This legislation will help countless veterans receive the retirement payments and benefits they earned. 

Our veterans have sacrificed enough and deserve to be supported long after they leave the https://t.co/lYEvvluhvY

This video was filmed prior to House Republicans sneaking through a vote of the Take Care of America’s Veterans Act, the largest VA Cut in history. Watch this video to see my take on it. https://t.co/FpPhHOWaZX

Today, on Veterans Day, we commend the brave men and women who answered the call to protect our Country.

We can best honor our veterans by ensuring they and their families receive the recognition, care and benefits they earned long after they return home. https://t.co/a2UYLVmIf7

The Trump Administration is moving to eliminate SNAP benefits for six million people - after five million people lost these important benefits due to Trump’s Big Ugly Law. 

This will make matters worse for those already struggling to put food on the table. https://t.co/6b1an172NA

Ahead of Veteran’s Day, I joined elected officials and neighbors in Port Chester to honor our local service men and women. 

To all service members - the sacrifices you’ve made for our country deserve a lifetime of gratitude. Thank you. https://t.co/Pv7jTfDmtM
Happy Diwali to all celebrating in Westchester and the Bronx! May this festival of lights bring new beginnings and joy to you and your loved ones. https://t.co/CkL1O7cHcW

This Administration was scheduled to deport dozens of Afghan immigrants back to their Taliban-controlled country, including those who risked their livelihoods to aid the United States during the conflict in Afghanistan.

That’s why I joined 66 of my colleagues to send a clear https://t.co/TAUFXYU7b4

From Chappaqua to Mamaroneck, the names of our towns carry the deep history and legacy of the Indigenous peoples who first lived on these lands.

Today and every month, we honor their rich culture and enduring memory. https://t.co/1Iv9pyTzPp

Inspiring the next generation of leaders means ensuring they have a seat at the table today.

I sat down with Mamaroneck High School students to discuss all things public service and how their voices can be heard right now. I look forward to seeing the amazing things these changemakers will do for their community!

It’s Election Day! 

Polls are open until 9 PM in New York. To find your polling location and more information, visit https://t.co/bWyvSFbd75. https://t.co/i9of7K3faZ

It was a pleasure spending time with the Business Council of Westchester (BCW) and the African American Men of Westchester (AAMW) at their 33rd Annual Brotherhood Breakfast. These organizations continue to drive the community forward through leadership, advocacy, and a commitment to building a stronger Westchester!

Good luck to all competing in the New York City Marathon today, and thank you to all the city workers, first responders, race organizers, and spectators who make this day unforgettable every year! https://t.co/oYMxbd4VrP
Happy Halloween! Whether you are handing out candy, trick-or-treating, or spending time with loved ones, I hope everyone has a safe, fun day! 🎃 https://t.co/aZomY4UAPO

As temperatures drop, your heating bills are going up. 

That’s why I am a proud co-sponsor of the Energy Bills Relief Act, so you don't have to choose between keeping your home warm and maintaining a manageable budget. https://t.co/u7QEg6LD9W
Seeing scary high prices when shopping for treats? See here how inflation is making your Halloween more expensive. https://t.co/BE92JHueiZ

Dolores Huerta was a fierce civil rights advocate, a feminist icon, and a powerful voice for labor workers across the country. We mourn her alongside her family, friends, and the many she inspired. https://t.co/eKAn8DRZuG

posts.text: Eight years ago today, 11 lives were taken in the horrific antisemitic attack at the Tree of Life synagogue. This tragic day serves as a reminder of the ongoing fight against hatred towards the Jewish community and the vital work required to protect religious freedom and provide https://t.co/ND1wZUBzbZ

Yesterday, I attended the unveiling of the new sign at the Westchester County Archives and Records Center honoring former County Executive Andy Spano. I joined Andy, Brenda and County Executive Ken Jenkins to celebrate Andy’s lifelong dedication to public service - a fitting https://t.co/xMwoZuWxCQ

Don't miss your chance to spend a semester living and working in D.C.! Applications for the spring internship program in our D.C. office are open now through November 20th. Find more information and the application at https://t.co/MpeKFdNbjB. https://t.co/MAgMCUADwL

Congratulations to New York Medical College on its 50th anniversary! I had the opportunity to speak at their celebration and honor Al DelBello, former Westchester County Executive and champion of bringing the Medical College to Westchester to serve our community. To many more https://t.co/KZomstntqL

According to the Ukrainian government, Russia abducted at least 20,000 Ukrainian children since the start of the full-scale invasion. That’s why I am proud to co-sponsor the bipartisan Justice for Ukrainian Children Act, which provides essential funds to aid in the return of abducted children, hold the perpetrators accountable, and requires regular reporting from the State Department on their efforts to return children to their homes.

Throughout the past year, I have had the honor of attending Co-Op building meetings to present building presidents with Congressional Records recognizing their leadership and dedication to their communities. 

Seeing their commitment to serving residents and ensuring all voices are heard, even in the largest housing cooperative in the world, is truly inspiring to see. Co-Op City is in good hands!

Recent clashes in the streets of Albania’s capital Tirana are concerning news for this relatively young democracy.

I encourage the avoidance of violent confrontation, and hope that respect for dialogue and democratic principles will prevail.

Last year, President Trump promised to restore $87 million in counterterrorism funding owed to New York, giving our first responders the resources they need to protect our communities and prepare for threats. Yet, that money remains missing.  
 
That is why I joined https://t.co/czVyFJD1Bp

Every second counts when someone suffers a stroke. To reduce the devastating effects of this life-threatening event, we must ensure patients have access to timely and high-quality care. I am proud to introduce a new bill alongside @RepDebDingell to provide first responders and medical professionals with the tools they need to treat stroke patients effectively, no matter their location. You can find the full bill text here: https://t.co/9rlbTnKSC0
Did you know that you can get regular updates from my office in your inbox? Sign up for my newsletter today to stay up to date! Follow this link here - https://t.co/JzHaUqsjjL https://t.co/l31lNEpIx5

At a time when our right to free and fair elections are under threat, I’m proud to have earned an 'A' grade from the Defend the Vote Action Fund for my record of pushing back on election corruption. Protecting our rights and freedoms is vital to our democracy, and I will continue to fight for voters across the country.

Parents and guardians should be able to send their children to school confident that they can focus on learning rather than face life-threatening violence. I am devastated by yesterday's shooting at Silver Rail Elementary in Oregon; my prayers go out to everyone affected and to the brave first responders at the scene. We must work towards a country free from fear by passing responsible gun safety measures to prevent such tragedies from devastating another community.

https://t.co/2g38nRPqcO

Today marks the start of the Medicare open enrollment period! Those eligible have until December 7th to compare options and choose a 2027 plan. For more information, visit https://t.co/h0Yh5iU7xt or call 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227). https://t.co/D16OfpKLVe

Mere weeks after President Trump signed a bill placing sanctions on anyone who buys Russian energy products, he turns around and announces the U.S. will be purchasing diesel from Russia. 

The result is a lifeline for Putin’s war effort and contradicts our nation’s clear policy of support for Ukraine. My colleagues and I strongly oppose this move by the President and will work to reinstate these sanctions to protect Ukraine’s sovereignty and security. 

https://t.co/b8nwWu6Yaz
Where is this American First promise we are always hearing about? https://t.co/lw6DiJ8xAi

As the first African American pastor at First Baptist Church of Bronxville, Westchester native Reverend Lamont S. Granby lived a life of compassion and service. Last year, I took to the House floor to honor his pastoral anniversary, and now we remember his life and legacy as he was taken from us too soon. May his memory be kept alive through his powerful words and service to all.

Today is a time to celebrate Italian heritage and Italian-Americans across our country. Being of Italian descent, I am proud of the traditions and culture that I can uphold and pass on to future generations for years to come. https://t.co/GStY5GhYAE

We recognize those Americans whose ancestors and cultures predate the Age of Exploration and still influence the American way of life. 

Today, we remember and appreciate the contributions that Indigenous Peoples have made for our country and will make for years to come. https://t.co/zN9M6JE3SE

While researching for the Food Access in Community Health Centers Act of 2026, I saw firsthand how Westchester Community Health Center and Feeding Westchester partner to ensure patients have food access. The success of this program in Westchester showcases how every community across the country could benefit amid rising food insecurity. I am proud to highlight our local partners as we work to implement these programs nationwide.

October is Domestic Violence Awareness Month. This month and every month, I stand with survivors and will continue working towards a world free from violence, fear, and abuse. If you or someone you know needs help, free, confidential support is available at https://t.co/QZq8959Tgh or by calling 800-799-SAFE.

Once again, ICE has recklessly put our community and our children in danger. Ruthless and unvetted agents are wreaking havoc on our cities to meet quotas set by the Trump administration. New Yorkers, and all Americans, have a right to know that they and their families are safe when they step outside their homes to go to work and school, most of all from their own government. I will continue to hold ICE accountable and call on this administration to bring an end to this violence.

This past Sunday, I had the privilege of joining the welcoming and vibrant congregation at Calvary Baptist Church for their Men’s Day Service. Gathering with your community in shared purpose was the perfect start to the week. 

Thank you to Reverend Trollinger for inviting me to be part of such a meaningful service!

It has been three years since Hamas launched the deadliest terrorist attack on Israel, a well planned and executed killing of civilians; this tragedy has not been forgotten. I join the world in remembering the thousands of people killed that day, the families torn apart, and the pain still felt by those affected. As violence persists three years later, we must not lose sight of the peace we need that will bring an end to the suffering of so many. The commitment to peace and the rejection of violence as a means to an end, must be acknowledged and adhered to by all parties in the region.

Following the President diverting $20 million in taxpayer dollars to spend on his own ads, strict oversight must be exercised to ensure other undisclosed spending ventures aren't being paid for by the American people. Pledging to reimburse those funds doesn't make this right, and firm measures must be put in place to ensure public funds never go towards vanity projects.

Amid unprecedented cuts to SNAP and Medicaid, I am proud to introduce the Food Access in Community Health Centers Act. This legislation will fund partnerships between community health centers and emergency feeding operations to expand food access at health centers. Thank you to @RepRobinKelly for her joint leadership on this, and to the many partners in our district who have inspired and supported this effort.

Mental health care is health care. During Mental Health Awareness Week, I encourage you to check in on yourself and your loved ones. If you or someone you know needs support, 988 is available to you. Find more information here: https://t.co/HErNGM9zbj https://t.co/tHuiaO7S7E

During this Hispanic Heritage month, I took to the House Floor to highlight some of the events and celebrations taking place to honor the vibrant Hispanic and Latino community we have in Westchester and the Bronx. To all celebrating, Que este mes esté lleno de alegría y tradición!
Happy Simchat Torah to all celebrating across Westchester and the Bronx! https://t.co/EuS8fEe6lz

Serving 75 million people each year, @newyorkbloodcenter volunteers and leaders play a vital role in ensuring there is a plentiful blood supply for those in need. I was honored to recognize these dedicated individuals for their service to NYBC and their commitment to bringing communities together to help save lives.

The allegations surrounding the assault at Cornell University are deeply disturbing and inexcusable. Students, and specifically women, should be able to focus on their education without the fear of becoming a victim of violent crime. I am calling for an independent and thorough investigation so that those affected receive the justice they deserve and universities across the country can strengthen their procedures to better protect victims.
Back home doing what I love - listening to seniors discuss what matters most to them and how we can make sure our government is delivering for older Americans. https://t.co/4T1bnxkl3C

I sent a letter to the White House calling for the immediate removal of https://t.co/SM3Ly3q29k, which gamifies mass deportations, MAHA regulations, and border detentions. The content of these games, which belittles crises currently facing Americans across the country, has no place on an official government platform, and the website must be removed immediately.

In New York, I had the opportunity to meet with the Prime Minister of Kosovo, Albin Kurti, to discuss how the United States can aid in their country's safety and sovereignty. It was a productive meeting capped off with receiving a display of commemorative 250th anniversary stamps to represent the celebrations of our country’s independence as we remain a partner in Kosovo’s fight for their own.

From scenic state park preserves to neighborhood green spaces, New York State is home to over 5 million acres of public lands.

On National Public Lands Day, I encourage everyone to get outside and explore the incredible state parks, historic sites, and trails available in your communities!
Chag Sukkot Sameach to all celebrating across Westchester and the Bronx! https://t.co/z0nsRvXuRA

funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.
